name: human-view
description: On a '#human' prompt, paints the current Codex task as a live view in a cmux browser pane, updated as the conversation progresses.

interface.shortDescription: Live task visualization in a cmux browser pane (opt-in with #human).
interface.longDescription: When a prompt contains the trigger token #human, Human View spawns a tiny loopback HTTP daemon and opens a cmux browser pane showing a task-themed live view. PostToolUse and Stop hooks update a state.json that the page polls every 800ms, so the view live-updates without any further cmux interaction or pane reloads. Sessions that never use #human stay completely dormant.
defaultPrompt: #human build an auth middleware with tests
#human refactor the parser and show me progress
